title: Japode Ads catalogue, version 1
description: One catalogue file holds every campaign the network may render. Each entry carries everything a banner shows, so a renderer never needs a second source.

version.description: Schema major version. Pinned per version path, so a v1 reader never has to inspect it to know what it is holding.

updated.description: When the catalogue was last assembled. Informational only.

campaigns.description: Every campaign, enabled or not. A disabled entry stays in the file so its id keeps meaning.

assetPath.description: Root-relative path on the ads origin, so a catalogue never hardcodes the domain it is served from.

slot.description: A layout family a campaign may be rendered into. The renderer owns the sizes; the catalogue only says which are allowed.

logo.description: The one image a banner is assembled around. Intrinsic size is declared so the slot can reserve space before the file loads.

srcDark.description: Optional replacement used on dark surroundings. Absent means src works on both.

theme.description: The campaign's own brand, travelling with the entry. A light set is required; a dark set is optional and falls back to light.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used by self-exclusion, by frequency memory and by counting, so it must never be reused for another product.

product.description: Display name of the advertised product.

headline.description: The banner's first line. Kept short so it survives the narrowest slot without wrapping to three lines.

support.description: One supporting sentence under the headline.

cta.description: The call to action. Its label is the link text, so it must read as a link on its own.

weight.description: Relative share of the random pick. Absent means 1; 0 keeps the entry in the file but out of rotation.

enabled.description: Absent means true. Set false to withdraw a campaign without deleting its history.

slots.description: Layout families this campaign may render into. Absent means all of them.

tags.description: Free-form topics a slot can filter on, both to include and to exclude.

lang.description: Languages this copy is written in, as BCP 47 tags. Absent means the copy is language-neutral.

excludeHosts.description: Hostnames that must never render this campaign, so a product does not advertise itself on its own site.
